{{Top|leg}}
'''Projective Telepathy''' was an [[Ee mental power]], and part of the mental skills category. It was similar to the [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] of the [[Projective Telepathy|same name]], although it was not a manifestation of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
